name: Upstage Solar
description: Korean LLM platform whose Solar Pro 4 models start with $10 of free credit.
overview: Upstage builds the Solar family of Korean-optimised LLMs and serves them through an OpenAI-compatible chat API. New accounts get $10 of credit, enough for a few million tokens on Solar Pro 4 or Solar Mini 4, which both carry 512K context. Older Solar Pro 2 and Mini models are end-of-life at the end of October 2026.
free_access: Solar Pro 4 and Mini 4 at 512K context
Document parsing and embeddings use the same credit
notes: One-time signup credit; the free tier no longer resets monthly.
